import pandas as pd
import json
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.ensemble import GradientBoostingClassifier
import numpy as np
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
np.random.seed(42)

# Suppress progress bars and display
pd.set_option("display.max_columns", None)
pd.set_option("display.width", None)

print("Loading data...")
train_df = pd.read_json("./input/train.json", lines=True)
test_df = pd.read_json("./input/test.json", lines=True)
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sampleSubmission.csv")

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}")
print(f"Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Drop ID and target from features
target_col = "requester_received_pizza"
id_cols = ["request_id"]

# Numerical features
numeric_features = [
    "number_of_downvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
    "number_of_upvotes_of_request_at_retrieval",
    "request_number_of_comments_at_retrieval",
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_retrieval",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_retrieval",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
]

# Categorical features (will use label encoding)
categorical_features = [
    "giver_username_if_known",
    "post_was_edited",
    "requester_user_flair",
    "requester_username",
]

# Text features
text_features = ["request_text_edit_aware", "request_title"]


# Extract numerical features safely
def extract_numeric(df, cols):
    result = {}
    for col in cols:
        if col in df.columns:
            clean = df[col].astype(float).fillna(0)
            result[col] = clean
        else:
            print(f"Column {col} not found in dataset")
    return pd.DataFrame(result)


X_train_num = extract_numeric(train_df, numeric_features)
X_test_num = extract_numeric(test_df, numeric_features)

# Handle categorical features with shared label mapping
X_train_cat_list = []
X_test_cat_list = []
cat_mapping = {}

for col in categorical_features:
    if col in train_df.columns:
        unique_vals = train_df[col].fillna("N/A").astype(str).unique()
        # Use N/A as default for missing values
        mapping = {"N/A": 0} + {v: i + 1 for i, v in enumerate(unique_vals)}

        X_train_cat = train_df[col].fillna("N/A").map(mapping).astype(float)
        X_train_cat_list.append(X_train_cat)

        # For test, handle unseen categories
        X_test_cat = test_df[col].fillna("N/A").map(mapping).astype(float)
        X_test_cat_list.append(X_test_cat)

    elif col in test_df.columns and col not in train_df.columns:
        print(f"Warning: {col} only in test set")

if X_train_cat_list:
    X_train_cat = pd.concat(X_train_cat_list, axis=1)
    X_test_cat = pd.concat(X_test_cat_list, axis=1)
else:
    X_train_cat = pd.DataFrame(index=train_df.index)
    X_test_cat = pd.DataFrame(index=test_df.index)

# Prepare text features
tfidf_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    max_features=2000, ngram_range=(1, 2), min_df=2, max_df=0.95
)

train_texts = df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").str.cat(sep=" ")
test_texts = df["request_text_edit_aware"].fillna("").str.cat(sep=" ")

# Better approach: concatenate per row
all_train_texts = []
all_test_texts = []

for i, row in train_df.iterrows():
    text_part = str(row.get("request_text_edit_aware", "") or "")
    title_part = str(row.get("request_title", "") or "")
    all_train_texts.append(text_part + " " + title_part)

for i, row in test_df.iterrows():
    text_part = str(row.get("request_text_edit_aware", "") or "")
    title_part = str(row.get("request_title", "") or "")
    all_test_texts.append(text_part + " " + title_part)

train_tfidf = tfidf_vectorizer.fit_transform(all_train_texts)
test_tfidf = tfidf_vectorizer.transform(all_test_texts)

# Combine all features
X_train_full = np.hstack(
    [X_train_num.values, X_train_cat.values.toarray(), train_tfidf.toarray()]
)
X_test_full = np.hstack(
    [X_test_num.values, X_test_cat.values.toarray(), test_tfidf.toarray()]
)

y_train = train_df[target_col].values

# Create proper validation split (hold-out that model never sees)
val_ratio = 0.2
train_size = int(len(y_train) * (1 - val_ratio))

X_val, X_trained, y_val, y_trained = train_test_split(
    X_train_full, y_train, test_size=val_ratio, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"Training samples: {len(y_trained)}")
print(f"Validation samples: {len(y_val)}")

# Scale features
scaler = StandardScaler()
X_trained_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X_trained)
X_val_scaled = scaler.transform(X_val)

# Train Gradient Boosting classifier (lighter than XGBoost)
print("\nTraining Gradient Boosting model...")
model = GradientBoostingClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=4,
    learning_rate=0.1,
    subsample=0.8,
    min_samples_leaf=10,
    random_state=42,
    verbose=False,
)

model.fit(X_trained_scaled, y_trained)

# Evaluate on held-out validation set
val_probs = model.predict_proba(X_val_scaled)[:, 1]
auc_val = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_probs)
print(f"\nValidation AUC-ROC Score: {auc_val:.4f}")

# Generate predictions on test set
print("\nGenerating test predictions...")
test_scaled = scaler.transform(X_test_full)
test_probs = model.predict_proba(test_scaled)[:, 1]

# Create submission
submissions = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": test_df["request_id"].values, "requester_received_pizza": test_probs}
)

# Ensure directory exists and save submission
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)
submissions.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print("\n=== SUMMARY ===")
print(f"Train samples: {len(y_train)}")
print(f"Test samples: {len(test_df)}")
print(f"Validation samples: {len(y_val)}")
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {auc_val:.4f}")
print("=== END ===")

# Print confirmation
print("\nSubmission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print("Number of submissions:", len(submissions))
